title: Ghost in the Wire
description: Someone used Aegis infrastructure to hit a community network. Recover three signed activity records and reconstruct the route. Evidence is scattered across the system.
objective: Recover records at Dev terminal, Audit terminal, and Research vault.
condition: Below 65% trace: +100 cr / +20 XP. Each optional archive: +100 cr / +15 XP; all three pay XP.
aftermath: The records link Aegis's contractor to Morrow's debt platform. Three unrelated jobs begin to look like one story.

lore.title: Authorized traffic
lore.text: AEGIS / SERVICE TICKET: The community network outage was recorded as authorized load testing. No request came from the network's owners. Approval originated in a Morrow procurement account.

lore.title: A borrowed key
lore.text: Audit excerpt: The same maintenance credential crossed three systems in eleven seconds. The credential belongs to an engineer whose access was revoked six months ago. Someone kept the key active.

lore.title: Someone answered
lore.text: Recovered radio transcript: NULL asked if anyone could still hear the neighborhood relay. Twelve operators answered. By dawn, the clinic and the night school were back online.
